stats.title: Where did the time go, meow?
stats.subtitle: Tuck each day’s screen time into your little journal.
stats.rangePrompt: Pick a few days. Let’s take a peek.
stats.rangeHint: Both dates included · Up to 30 days
stats.invalidRange: Those dates look a little tangled. Choose 1–30 days, starting before or on the end date, with no future dates.
stats.notes: How do these numbers work, meow?
stats.noteSampling: Active time is accumulated at the heartbeat interval (30 seconds by default). Lost samples are not counted. Only active foreground use counts, excluding idle time. This is not device uptime or working time.
stats.noteAverage: Recorded-day average = recorded active time ÷ recorded days, including explicitly recorded zeroes. Missing days do not mean no use and are excluded from the average.
stats.noteToday: Dates use {{timeZone}}. Today’s journal is still filling up; totals and averages include its partial record. Historical details show daily app totals only.
stats.loadError: Couldn’t fetch your little journal. Try again in a moment.
stats.chartHint: Tap a bar to peek at that day. The dashed line is the recorded-day average; hatching means missing data, not zero use.
stats.appsHint: Foreground app totals for the selected dates
stats.noApps: No app footprints here yet, meow.
stats.details: A little page for every day
stats.detailsHint: Every day has a place. Tap a row to open it.
stats.missingDetail: No usage record arrived for this day, meow. Reporting may have stopped; this does not mean the device was unused.
stats.todayHint: Today isn’t over yet. This is what the journal has counted so far.
